title: Casper and the Visitor
author: Mirabel Vane
blurb: Lior Eastwick, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must finish the ritual the founders started before the well refills.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
